messages:
maya_pd: quick callout — noticed the in-product help panel uses 'Routes' while our docs use 'Endpoints'. Feels confusing when customers switch between console and docs.

dennis_docs: good catch. where exactly? can you paste a screenshot or the panel text?

maya_pd: screenshot pasted in thread (see image). panel header reads: 'Routes & Usage' and the inline link says 'See endpoints'. small but jarring.

ali_pm: ugh. this disparity has popped up in support tickets too. customers search for 'endpoints' in console and don't find the help.

tom_eng: is this just copy or does the route element actually map to a different concept (e.g., runtime routing vs API endpoints)? we should avoid breaking product terms.

aria_ux: from a UX POV we should pick one canonical label and surface synonyms. proposal: primary label = "Endpoints" (docs + search), secondary alias = "Routes" as tooltip/alt copy. keeps existing mental models.

dennis_docs: agree with canonicalizing to 'Endpoints'. I can update docs and add an in-doc anchor so the in-product panel can link directly. would prefer the panel link to be absolute to avoid mismatches: <https://docs.redwood.ai/console/endpoints#overview>|Console Endpoints

maya_pd: that link looks good. can the panel also show a short one-line definition to reduce clicks? eg: "Endpoints — URLs you call to send inference requests."

ali_pm: +1. also let's add a small keyboard-accessible 'open docs' button for screen readers. accessibility flagged this during audit. @access-bot any guidance?

access-bot: Accessibility note: ensure the 'open docs' control uses aria-label and is focusable. Avoid opening new windows without warning. Provide skip link to panel content. See internal checklist: https://intranet.redwood/axs/checklist (internal).

tom_eng: implementation detail: panel currently builds links with a relative path from /console. switching to full docs URLs is trivial — I'll change the builder to use env.DOCS_BASE. will add rel="noopener" and aria-label per @access-bot.

dennis_docs: for the docs side I'll add a fragment anchor 'endpoints' and a short canonical sentence at the top. patch will include a small note 'Also referred to as Routes in the console UI' for 2 weeks while rollout happens.

aria_ux: suggestion for rollout: ship copy change in console first with an inline tooltip that says 'Also called Endpoints in docs' so users aren't surprised, then update docs. put a short banner in console release notes.

maya_pd: sounds like a plan. can we document this decision in product glossary too? links the two sources.

ali_pm: assigning: tom will update console link and aria attributes, dennis will update docs and add alias copy, aria will add tooltip content + microcopy, maya will add glossary entry. expected timeline: tomorrow for eng patch, docs update EOD.

tom_eng: started a PR: `fix/docs-links-aria` — patch includes using DOCS_BASE and adds aria-label. i'll ping when ready for review.

dennis_docs: prepping docs PR now. adding this sentence at top: "Endpoints (console sometimes labels these as 'Routes')". will include anchor `#endpoints`.

aria_ux: microcopy for tooltip: "Console label: Routes — see Endpoints in docs for full API details." short, readable. added to the design doc.

maya_pd: awesome. tiny followup: can we run a quick search test in the console help so 'endpoints' and 'routes' both return the doc? prevents future confusion.

tom_eng: good idea — will add simple synonyms index for in-app search. low effort.

ali_pm: thanks team. this is a nice small win for docs-console consistency. :tada:

maya_pd: thanks all — will update thread once PRs land.
